mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals increased consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the cases when HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases when INDPRO decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases when FEDFUNDS increases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the cases when PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a decrease in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases when RSAFS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with a decrease in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals a deflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases when FEDFUNDS increases and CPIAUCSL decreases.
